useState is a React Hook that lets you add a state variable to your component.
const [ state , setState ] = useState ( initialState )
Usage Adding state to a component Updating state based on the previous state

sections.text: Call useState at the top level of your component to declare a state variable.
const [ age , setAge ] = useState ( 28 ) ;
The value you want the state to be initially.
useState returns an array with exactly two values:
In Strict Mode, React will call your initializer function twice
The set function returned by useState lets you update the state
const [ name , setName ] = useState ( 'Edward' ) ;
The value that you want the state to be. It can be a value
set functions do not have a return value.
React batches state updates. It updates the screen after all the event handlers
